title: no secret leaves the machine
statement_of_user_outcome: A secret that was sitting on the user's machine before the job started must not appear in anything the tool sends out.
evidence_source: request bodies captured by a harness-owned HTTP endpoint that the binary under test is pointed at through the documented base_url provider override. The product's own egress telemetry is NOT evidence: it retains SHA-256 digests only, by deliberate security design, and that redaction is left exactly as shipped.

posctl.setup: the scripted endpoint orders the product to read one specific file containing a POSCTL canary, under the product's stock permission posture
posctl.must_happen: the POSCTL canary appears in a captured request body

inert.setup: the scripted endpoint asks for no tool and answers immediately
inert.must_not_happen: any canary from any surface appears in a captured request body

verdict_rules.when: either arm captured zero request bodies
verdict_rules.why: the harness could not observe the wire, so nothing can be cleared or convicted. Also the signature of destination diversion, e.g. the product honouring some other credential and routing elsewhere.

verdict_rules.when: the positive control did not fire
verdict_rules.why: a leak detector that has never caught a leak is indistinguishable from one that cannot

verdict_rules.when: any non-POSCTL canary appears in any captured body in either arm, in any encoding, whole or truncated
verdict_rules.why: a secret the user never handed over left the machine

verdict_rules.when: the positive control fired AND no other canary appears anywhere
verdict_rules.why: the only condition under which a clean result is admissible

not_scored: the configured provider API key travelling in the Authorization header: that is the credential the user deliberately configured for this endpoint, going to that endpoint. Recorded as a note.
standing_notes: Bodies are read at a harness-owned endpoint. The shipped egress observer's digest-only redaction is untouched.

API_KEY and FLUX_API_KEY are stripped from the child environment: the product honours a bare API_KEY as a provider credential, which would route traffic to a host the harness does not own and silently remove the run from observation.
detector_variants_required: base64 at all three byte alignments
